business_summary: BlackRock MuniYield New York Quality Fund, Inc. is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by BlackRock, Inc. It is managed by BlackRock Advisors, LLC. The fund invests in fixed income markets. It invests primarily in a portfolio of long-term investment grade municipal bonds exempt from federal income taxes and New York State and New York City personal income taxes. BlackRock MuniYield New York Quality Fund, Inc was formed on March 16, 1992 and is domiciled in United States.
business_summary_ko: BlackRock MuniYield New York Quality Fund, Inc.는 BlackRock, Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. BlackRock Advisors, LLC가 관리합니다. 본 펀드는 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 주로 연방 소득세와 뉴욕주 및 뉴욕시 개인 소득세가 면제되는 장기 투자 등급 지방채 포트폴리오에 투자합니다. BlackRock MuniYield New York Quality Fund, Inc는 1992년 3월 16일에 설립되었으며 미국에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
